claim: Patchline ships an external-validity transport estimate re-weighting results to a target population. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the external-validity transport claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make external-validity-transport-gate`.
